question: Is n^2+n+41 prime for every nonnegative integer n? Determine the truth of the statement and support your conclusion.

semantic_content.answer: No. At n = 40, n^2+n+41 = 40^2+40+41 = 1681 = 41^2, so it is composite. Thus the statement is false.
